description: DEFAULT FIRST TOOL for a user who describes a problem, desired outcome, or need without naming a specific Evercraft offer. Match the natural-language intent to the smallest current public-safe Evercraft capability. Use discover_offers only when the user explicitly wants to browse the catalog; use get_offer only after a match when deeper details are needed. Results may be sell-now or discovery-only and must be interpreted using commercial_state and invocation_status. Returns no result when confidence is too weak. Read-only; does not purchase anything.

intent.description: The user problem or desired outcome in natural language.

name: match_offer
title: Match a problem to Evercraft
